description: Places many guests in the selected wedding's rooms in one call, from a rule (reply, group, named guests, optionally limited to a place or rooms) or from a list of rooms and guests. Rooms are filled to their bed counts with each household kept together; held-back and full rooms are skipped, and a rule places only guests not yet in a room. Only guests recorded as 13 or older are placed. Results list who was placed in each room with its occupancy, and every skipped guest with a reason. By default it only plans and places no one; guests are placed when dry_run is false. At most 200 guests are placed per call. Requires sign-in and an Aisle membership.

assignments.description: Your own list of rooms and guests; can move guests already placed. Exclusive with fill.

room_id.description: A room in the selected wedding.

dry_run.description: When true or omitted, reports the placements and skipped guests that would result and places no one. Set to false to place guests.

fill.description: A rule the server packs into open rooms. Only guests not yet in a room are considered. Exclusive with assignments.

guest_ids.description: Only these guests. Named guests are taken even when declined.

include_household.description: Also place the rest of each match’s household. Default true.

share_rooms.description: Let different households share a room. Default false; set it only when the couple has said unrelated guests may share.

tag.description: Only guests in this group, ignoring case.

set_rsvp_status.description: Also record this reply for every guest who lands in a room.

wedding_id.description: Identifier of a wedding the signed-in account can manage. Required when the account has multiple weddings.

name: place_my_guests_in_rooms
title: Place Guests In Rooms
